job: Clifton College Garage Site, Clifton Park Road, Bristol

stages.title: Foundation and ground floor slab
stages.desc: The 2-course 6in XR35 foundation with the Nudura Brick Ledge for the natural stone outer leaf (on a strip footing, by others) and the ground-bearing slab with insulation and screed (indicative).

stages.title: Ground floor walls, windows and partitions
stages.desc: Ground-floor 6in XR35 walls (7 courses) with the bay, porch and the internal load-bearing walls; windows, the sliding doors and the entrance doors (indicative); timber stud partitions with pattressing in the WC / utility.

stages.title: First floor
stages.desc: PS10 metal-web first floor with the indicative steels (engineer), the oriel corbel and the stairs; the GF flat roofs (wrap, porch, bay) inside their ICF parapets; first-floor walls, windows and partitions.

stages.title: Second floor, gables and oriel
stages.desc: PS10 metal-web second floor; the 2F walls with the front and rear parapet gables, the wing gable and the oriel, raked to the 50 degree roof; second-floor windows. The 2F partitions sit under the sloping ceiling and are not modelled (BOQ assumption).

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Cut roofs (indicative - engineer): the main 50 degree roof between the parapet gables, the wing B cross gable and the oriel dormer, carried over the main slopes on lay boards with diminishing rafters @400 from their ridges; C24 rafters @400, clay double Roman tiles (per the elevations).
